_doc: A13 (display text). The wording shown on the map for modes, statuses, caveats, boundaries and sources; read only by B21. Field meanings: docs/configuration.md#configui_textjson-a13-display-text. Validate with `make check-config`.

ok.label: Benchmark available
ok.text: Every value shown is measured against this area's local benchmark.

no_zori.label: No rent benchmark
no_zori.text: Zillow publishes no rent index for any ZIP code in this MHA, so rent adequacy cannot be measured. The HUD Small Area Fair Market Rent cross-check is still shown.

piti_only_no_zori.label: Ownership cost without utilities
piti_only_no_zori.text: This MHA has a home value but no Zillow rent index, so there is no utilities estimate. Buy values compare BAH with mortgage, property tax and insurance only, which overstates how far BAH goes.

no_home_value.label: No home-value benchmark
no_home_value.text: Zillow publishes no home value index for any ZIP code in this MHA, so buy adequacy cannot be measured.

ccg_no_benchmark.label: BAH rate only
ccg_no_benchmark.text: This is a County Cost Group. DoD publishes no rent/utilities split for it and many of its rural ZIP codes have no rent index, so only its BAH rate is shown.

no_rate.label: No BAH rate
no_rate.text: These ZIP codes are in U.S. territories, where members receive Overseas Housing Allowance instead of BAH. DTMO lists them without a BAH rate.

ccg_geometry.title: Approximate boundary
ccg_geometry.text: DoD publishes no boundaries for County Cost Groups or the territory bucket. This outline joins the Census ZIP Code Tabulation Areas of the ZIP codes DTMO assigns to the area.

outside_cluster_scope.title: Outside the cluster analysis
outside_cluster_scope.text: The spatial cluster analysis covers MHAs in the continental United States. This area is shown with its values but was not part of that analysis.

ccg_no_benchmark.title: No adequacy measure
ccg_no_benchmark.text: County Cost Groups have no local benchmark in this project, so only the BAH rate is shown.

utilities_grossed_up.title: Utilities estimated
utilities_grossed_up.text: Zillow's rent index excludes utilities, while BAH covers rent plus utilities. The rent is grossed up with DoD's rent/utilities split for this MHA.

piti_only_no_zori.title: Utilities not included
piti_only_no_zori.text: No utilities estimate exists for this MHA, so the ownership cost covers mortgage, property tax and insurance only.

tax_insurance_locality.title: Local tax and insurance
tax_insurance_locality.text: Property tax is this MHA's effective rate from the Census American Community Survey (2020-2024). Insurance is the median premium per policy across its ZIP codes, from the Treasury Federal Insurance Office.

tax_state_fallback.title: State tax rate
tax_state_fallback.text: No local property-tax data was usable for this MHA, so the rate across its state's MHAs is used.

insurance_state_fallback.title: State insurance premium
insurance_state_fallback.text: No ZIP code in this MHA has published insurance data, so the median premium across its state's MHAs is used.

insurance_2022_dollars.title: Insurance in 2022 dollars
insurance_2022_dollars.text: Insurance premiums are 2022 figures from the Treasury Federal Insurance Office, the latest published, used without adjustment. Premiums have risen since, so 2026 ownership costs are understated.

lisa_exploratory.title: Exploratory clusters
lisa_exploratory.text: Local clusters are shown where a test is significant at p < 0.05 without correcting for testing every MHA at once, so some are expected by chance. Areas outlined in black stay significant after a false-discovery-rate correction.

global_caveats.title: How adequacy is measured
global_caveats.text: By law, BAH equals the local cost of adequate housing minus a member cost share of 5% of the national average for the pay grade. An adequacy ratio of 1.00 means BAH plus that cost share exactly covers the local benchmark.

global_caveats.title: Market rents, not DoD survey rents
global_caveats.text: Local rent is the median of Zillow's rent index across the MHA's ZIP codes, a measure of typical asking rents for all homes. DoD's own survey prices specific dwelling types for each pay grade.

global_caveats.title: Benchmarks differ in timing
global_caveats.text: BAH rates are for the BAH year shown, while each benchmark covers its own period. The data windows list the months and years used.

global_caveats.title: Boundaries are approximate
global_caveats.text: Area outlines are built from Census ZIP Code Tabulation Areas. PO-box and single-site ZIP codes have no tabulation area and are not drawn, although the areas they belong to still have outlines.

geometry.method: Census 2020 ZIP Code Tabulation Areas, dissolved through DTMO's assignment of ZIP codes to Military Housing Areas, County Cost Groups and the territory bucket.
geometry.authority: DoD publishes no boundary layer for any of these areas. MHA outlines are a reconstruction from ZIP codes; County Cost Group and territory outlines are marked as approximate.
